review.scope: Focused source-only follow-up at b9a51fc9: verification of the four suggestions from HANDOVER_PROTECTED_INTAKE_REVIEW_20260907 (sparse glob paths, named error codes, initialize flag scoping, backup top-level files) in orchestrator/publication_candidate.py, orchestrator/protected_handover.py, orchestrator/operations_backup.py; fresh review of newly prepared orchestrator/actions_admission_collector.py, orchestrator/actions_admission_wait.py, orchestrator/actions_admission_transport.py, Broker.actions_admission; and current coordinator report snapshot capture in handover_runtime.scheduled_report/operations_report.finalize, with supplied tests and the review artifact as context. No tests executed, no installation or activation claimed; Actions workflow wiring remains pending; scientific/credential/activation gates unchanged.
findings: RESOLVED (verified in source): sparse-checkout glob finding — sparse_paths now rejects '*?[]\\' and CR/LF with LITERAL_SPARSE_PATH_REQUIRED on both prepare and receive, and the '/'-anchored patterns neutralize leading '!'/'#'; test_glob_paths_cannot_materialize_legacy_baseline covers '*.md', 'question?.md', '[abc].md'. Residual untested edge (suggestion, low): a path with a trailing space cannot be represented (gitignore trims trailing spaces; backslash escaping is rejected), so its file silently fails to materialize while receive still returns STAGED_NOT_PUBLISHED; no publication consequence since publish pushes commits, not the worktree. Smallest fix: reject leading/trailing whitespace in sparse_paths.

RESOLVED (verified in source): Broker.operator('initialize') now saves and restores ledger.allow_initialization in try/finally; test_initialization_permission_is_scoped_even_on_existing_state asserts the flag is False after LIMITER_STATE_ALREADY_EXISTS, so the absent-ref lease guard is no longer disarmed for the broker lifetime.

RESOLVED (verified in source): operations_backup.backup now copies top-level regular files under outputs and refuses special files (BACKUP_SPECIAL_FILE_REJECTED); test_legacy_backup_preserves_top_level_original_files verifies restored bytes.

PARTIALLY RESOLVED (verified in source): named fail-closed codes — publication_candidate.git now maps timeout/cat-file/bundle failures to CANDIDATE_GIT_TIMEOUT / CANDIDATE_GIT_OBJECT_UNAVAILABLE / CANDIDATE_BUNDLE_INVALID / CANDIDATE_GIT_OPERATION_FAILED and os.link OSError to CANDIDATE_BUNDLE_LINK_FAILED_OR_UNSUPPORTED. zipfile.BadZipFile in actions_admission.verify remains unwrapped (see next finding).

SUGGESTION (verified in source, untested; affected task: Actions collector): zipfile.BadZipFile (and zlib.error) from a corrupt artifact archive escapes actions_admission_collector._reconcile's except (ValueError,KeyError,TypeError,OSError), aborting the remaining manifest entries for that invocation without the durable blocked.json the docstring promises. The pre-network attempt marker persists, so the 3-read cap holds and behavior stays fail-closed with no credential/URL leak; consequence is one malformed artifact delaying independent requests to the next invocation plus an unnamed traceback. Smallest fix: wrap ZipFile parsing in verify with a named ValueError (e.g., ACTIONS_ARCHIVE_INVALID) or add zipfile.BadZipFile to the collector's except tuple.

SUGGESTION (verified in source, untested; affected task: scheduled reports): handover_runtime.scheduled_report embeds the full unbounded coordinator_tasks list into task_state, while operations_report.finalize enforces text(context_bytes, limit=20000); once the coordinator accumulates roughly 150-200 tasks the context exceeds the limit and the schedule phase blocks permanently with EVIDENCE_OR_CONFIGURATION_REQUIRES_RECONCILIATION. Fail-closed, but a self-inflicted loss of nightly reporting. Smallest fix: bound the snapshot (status counts plus a capped task list) before finalize.

OBSERVATION (verified in source, acknowledged in comments): a crash or race between enqueue_report and Coordinator.schedule leaves orphaned immutable packet/report files and an unreferenced QUEUED review row; coordinator_observed_at makes each retried same-day identity distinct, so orphans can accumulate one per failed attempt. No authority is conferred and losers converge on ALREADY_SCHEDULED; note for maintenance only. Similarly, receive() retains each failed incoming bundle (≤1 MB, controller-authenticated) under cache.parent for private reconciliation — bounded per request but unbounded in aggregate.

VERIFIED POSITIVES (source) for the new collector/waiter: manifest bounded at 16 under an exclusive collector lock; read attempts persisted immutably before network access with a durable 3-read cap; admission identity established by the authenticated API (repository id 1323461276, run/attempt/source/branch/workflow_path binding, workflow bytes SHA-256, unique un-expired artifact, 64 KiB caps), never by requester JSON — broker.actions_admission additionally refuses non-pinned sources; failures persist fixed named reasons only, no API error text or signed URLs; lost local receipts reconcile through shared CAS duplicate_admission without a second charge (test-covered); transport never forwards Authorization to signed storage, captures rather than follows the redirect, and allowlists storage hosts; the waiter is credential-free, a timeout returns BLOCKED ADMISSION_WAIT_TIMEOUT and never admits, halt blocks new requests while an already-admitted attempt survives, and policy-pin or source/branch drift refuses with SHARED_POLICY_BINDING_CHANGED / SHARED_ADMISSION_BINDING_CHANGED. Workflow wiring remains pending and is not claimed active.

SNAPSHOT/ARTIFACT HONESTY (verified from supplied files): the coordinator snapshot exposes only task id/status/reason — no bindings, prompts, or private payloads — with an explicit evidence_scope disclaimer (test-covered); the HANDOVER_PROTECTED_INTAKE_REVIEW_20260907 artifact honestly records reviewed commit cba7043, mixed actual model usage (claude-haiku-4-5 subagent alongside claude-fable-5), not-yet-installed status, and investigator notes distinguishing the two pre-model failures. Existing scientific/credential/activation gates, operator-only reset/initialize, midnight-latched halt, and the single authorized publication branch/remote are preserved unchanged in this source. Source-only review: no tests executed, no hosted or installation evidence claimed.
